notes.title: My Diggy Dog 2 - About us
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37818259/2bf3d4de0396cd432ad922deebbeb4d40d7cec75.jpg[/img]


We are passionate about the games, development, art and unique stories. It’s been a while we’ve been trying to create games along with the major work, although we had little experience and we were distracted frequently. We dedicated plenty of efforts, we failed and learnt from our failures. Thus, we’ve developed the “Diggy dog” game as well as several other mini-games. 

We faced with many hardships and shortcomings of the first version. Besides that, we met many people who are not indifferent with the story of Diggy Dog. The gamers are looking for the continuation.
Nine months ago, we gathered a team of 4 people and decided to postpone all our business in order to make the second part of the game.

Having fun with the process of creating the games is crucial for us, that’s why we came up with several interesting things in game development. 

Here are some of them:
[list]
[*] There are 4 people in the development team. All of four are dog-owners. 
[*] The main character is drawn from the artist's dog, even the red collar.
[*] We were inspired by Indiana Jones while developing the set of the main characters. Our old archaeologist is a kind of retired Jones. We thought, what if he had a dog?
[*] The dog is named after the main character of the movie "Back to the future" who traveled back in time with a cheerful gray-haired old scientist.
[/list]
